title: Horae beatae Mariae virginis (use of Paris)
shelf_note: No tradition or collection given in the packet. The pages are a richly illuminated Book of Hours (Matins incipits under miniatures, a French devotional prayer), consistent with the title.
structure_note: No structure counts in the packet. The pencil foliation on the images (36? on p5, 57 on p10, 85 on p14) matches the OCR's page-num where given. No page has a translation (translation null on all three).

book_verdict: The main text under each miniature is read well on all three pages: the Matins incipits are exact and the French prayer is mostly right, except that its first word is misread ("Out" for "Tout") and two words are slipped. But every page also transcribes the facing leaf's cut-off column as a garbled 'margin', which an expert would notice at once, and no page is translated.
